annotations.text:
Three views of one pool, one toggle apart. Cards is the default.

What a card carries that a row cannot: the situation. Four of these ten are near-worthless on points alone, but the copy says why — Martinelli is in Al-Hilal talks, Tosin is out of Chelsea's plans, Estêvão is 19 behind a crowded front line.

Explorer: 218 real players, 2025/26, every axis pickable. Defaults to value against PPG, so the top-left quadrant is literally the bargain bin.

Click a point to inspect. Dot size is minutes. Value uses a log scale — the pool runs €0.20m to €220m.

Two layers, never blended.

Football layer (serif, prose): who this footballer is. Real-world only — portable back to Futbolpedia.

League layer (mono, ledger): what he is worth in your league. Gaffa scoring, never fed to the outlook.

Designed for the phone, not reflowed onto it.

Chrome is translucent and content scrolls under it; the three stacked filter rows collapse to one scrolling rail plus a Filters button; every control clears a 44px target.

The Explorer has no hover to fall back on, so a tap selects and a bottom sheet carries the detail — each dot's touch target is 34px around a 7-13px painted dot, because a dense scatter is otherwise unhittable with a thumb.
